title: Water and the Water Cycle
seo_title: Grade 2 Science: Water and the Water Cycle Worksheets (BC Curriculum)
standard_text: Water is essential to all living things and it cycles through the environment: water sources (oceans, lakes, rivers, wells, glaciers), water conservation, the water cycle (evaporation, condensation, precipitation, runoff) and First Peoples knowledge of water. (summary of BC's Curriculum, Science 2, Earth and Space Science)
meta_desc: Free Grade 2 science worksheets (BC): where water comes from, the water cycle, rain and snow, saving water and clean water. 100 picture questions with answers.
body_html:
How to think about it

All living things need water.

  • The Sun warms water and it rises (evaporation).
  • It cools into clouds (condensation).
  • It falls as rain or snow (precipitation).
Example

What makes puddles dry up?

The Sun warms the water.

Answer: evaporation

Example

Is rain or snow precipitation?

Both fall from clouds.

Answer: both

Common mistakes

  • Thinking water is used up for good.
  • Thinking clouds are made of smoke.
